ghoulkin.approach: Keep room to step away from a lunge. Their bodies remain vulnerable to ordinary steel; a terrible origin does not make them untouchable.

wychwood_stalker.approach: Watch the flank, not only the creature in front. An Iron Trap can interrupt a nearby approach, but it is spent when set.

wychwood_raider.approach: Do not spend every breath chasing a feint. Keep a clear retreat and strike after its committed attack.

wychwood_brute.approach: Leave room around the heavy windup. A bomb can interrupt close pressure; it is not a substitute for escaping the blow.

bog_wretch.approach: Moon Oil and a clean interruption can expose the carried memory. Exposing it is not the same decision as destroying it; the fragment's fate is a separate choice.

gravebound_knight.approach: Respect the raised guard. A clear parry creates an opening; Rot Oil suits the undead body.

bell_eater.approach: Watch the clapper and leave the bell's ring. Reading two disturbed graves reveals a shared pull and gives time to read its first tell. A released rope and mourning stone also matter.

rootbound_colossus.approach: The marked roots feed the armoured heart. Redirect root channels and protect the name-board. A burning opening does not erase the human record trapped beneath it.

ashwing.approach: Move across the ash plume rather than along it. An Oathfire hit can interrupt charged breath. The mill's ventilation and the workers' escape are part of surviving this encounter.

halvern_boss.approach: A clean parry can make Halvern yield. When he lowers his blade, speak to the memory. His bounded testimony, release and defeat are different outcomes, not interchangeable victories.

white_hart_avatar.approach: Watch where a memory echo ends before the antlers follow. The covenant is a choice about the living and the dead, not a compulsory hunt. Hear the account before choosing violence.

bandit.approach: A person with a weapon is still a physical opponent. Keep your footing, guard a committed strike and leave space to retreat. Equipment does not establish why this person chose the road.

redroot_potion.body: A remedy to recover after an injury. Drinking uses one potion; it restores health immediately, up to your current maximum.

bitterleaf_tonic.body: A remedy for spent breath. Drinking uses one tonic; it restores stamina immediately, up to your current maximum.

ash_bomb.body: Throw a burst of hot ash at enemies close to Kael. Throwing uses one bomb immediately, including when no enemy is within reach.

moon_oil.body: Select a blade coating suited to spirit weaknesses. The coating remains selected until replaced; applying it does not spend a bottle.

effects.title: Blade coating
effects.text: Gives blade contacts the spirit tag. Its effect depends on the target's weakness.

rot_oil.body: Select a blade coating suited to undead weaknesses. The coating remains selected until replaced; applying it does not spend a bottle.

effects.title: Blade coating
effects.text: Gives blade contacts the undead tag. Its effect depends on the target's weakness.

iron_trap.body: Use a sprung iron jaw to interrupt a nearby enemy's approach. Setting a trap spends one immediately, including when no enemy is close enough to catch.

effects.title: Use
effects.text: Best used with an enemy close to Kael; it does not place a permanent trap on the road.

standard_arrow.body: An ordinary hunting arrow. Selecting a bundle does not spend an arrow; releasing a bow shot spends one. Arrows are replenished through supplies and shops, not field crafting.

bodkin_arrow.body: A heavier iron-headed shot, carried in a smaller bundle. Selecting it does not spend an arrow; releasing a bow shot spends one. The comparison below is base impact damage before a target's response.

ashfire_arrow.body: An arrow wrapped with an ember-bright head. Selecting it does not spend an arrow; releasing a bow shot spends one. The comparison below is base impact damage before a target's response.

known_use.title: The name you restored
known_use.body: The chapel names and ritual stones give time to read the Bog Wretch's approach. Moon Oil and clean interruptions can expose its memory. Preparation offers an opening; no purchase is required to decide how to answer the account.

known_use.title: Mira's refined formula
known_use.body: Your learned formula returns one mooncap after a successful craft. You still need the full recipe in hand to begin; the quote shows both the required ingredients and the return.
